- Gate ② same file/area at 682/682 ceiling: one dev balances the whole add/cut ledger once instead of four sequential devs each scavenging what the previous one left.
- Gate ③ all graded: every member is a triage- or seat-graded queue card with a chosen lead recorded in its grading comment; no open decisions.
- Gate ④ per-member verifiable, one commit per member, one `Fixes #<n>` line each:

Mechanism details may live in the runbook with SKILL.md carrying the principle, per house layering.
  - #10544 — the claim protocol gains the DECISION re-read, symmetrical to the race re-read: before writing a brief, read the card's comments to the end and quote any maintainer ruling as binding, or state none exists.
  - #10523 — the tier-fuse clause states that a `mode:subagent` reading of `get_session` measures the DISPATCHING session (the fuse is valid only for seat sessions), so clause-② subagent dispatches always keep `needs:contract-review` and the at-the-floor skip path is seat-session-only.
  - #10508 — the 机械守卫索引 gains the `scripts/pm/git-history.mjs` row (the card's drafted wording), and AGENTS.md's guard index gains its one-line entry.
- Gate ⑤ exclusion list: #10986 (new working-agreement addition — different shape AND likely lands partly in AGENTS.md working agreements; dispatched separately next, serialized behind this PR on any shared file). #10913-class cards do not exist in this lane; H8/readings/label families are different files entirely.

Member claims on #10544/#10523/#10508 point here; no per-member branches by design.
